hero.name: Legacy Rowan
hero.ambition: Protect the place I call home

world.name: The Rowan Vale

locations.name: Hearthmere
locations.description: A small settlement of hearth fires, kitchen gardens, and familiar faces. Ashfall fever has reached its households; the old shrine is still a place to seek help. Willing ancestral rites and the study of the dead are permitted; coercion and grave theft remain crimes.

locations.name: Brindlehall
locations.description: The region’s busy city gathers an academy, a guild market, and a sworn order behind its stone walls. Fever wards are filling, and scholars disagree over the cause. Willing ancestral rites and the study of the dead are permitted; coercion and grave theft remain crimes.

locations.name: Fernbridge
locations.description: A riverside village where millers, ferrymen, and herbalists trade news. Families are sheltering travelers fleeing Ashfall fever. Willing ancestral rites and the study of the dead are permitted; coercion and grave theft remain crimes.

locations.name: The Lantern Thicket
locations.description: Old trails connect both villages beneath a canopy of moss and copper leaves. Healing herbs grow here, alongside hungry beasts and abandoned camps. The nearest settlement’s law governs witnessed acts.

locations.name: The Hollow Archive
locations.description: An abandoned sanctuary beyond the forest holds sealed research and the memories of its former keepers. Licensed expeditions may study its ancestral records; disturbing remains without consent invites scrutiny.

world.laws: Local councils set their own rules. In Brindlehall, necromancy is permitted; in Hearthmere, it is permitted; in Fernbridge, it is permitted. Authorities act on witnesses, reports, and discovered evidence. Willing ancestral contact, grave theft, and unwilling soul binding are treated as different acts.

mentors.name: Dame Mara Alder
mentors.description: A sworn protector offers training and an initiation founded on a visible oath of mercy and protection.

mentors.name: Scholar Tamsin
mentors.description: A physician teaches consensual ancestral rites and sponsors students studying the ruined archive.

mentors.name: Vey the Quiet
mentors.description: A discreet contact offers a test of stealth and judgment, with the terms disclosed before accepting.

companions.name: Mira
companions.goal: Earn a place in the Lantern Order without abandoning old friends.
memories: At seven, you spoke up when I was falsely accused.

companions.name: Orrin
companions.goal: Find a remedy for the fever and keep his family safe.

companions.name: Kest
companions.goal: Make the western road safe enough to visit a missing sibling.
values: Do not prey on desperate families

legal.description: No local charges or known evidence.

event.title: A door into the wider world
event.body: A visiting teacher brings academy books to your village. Tuition is beyond your family, but a service scholarship is available. What kind of education do you pursue?

choices.label: Earn a service scholarship
choices.description: Gain scholarship and arcana. Begin adulthood with 20 gold and one clinic shift promised within 35 days.

choices.label: Learn a useful trade
choices.description: Gain survival and persuasion. Begin with an apprenticeship and 28 extra gold.

choices.label: Study with a retired guard
choices.description: Gain weapons and defense. Your teacher introduces you to the local order.

obligations.title: Repay a service scholarship with a clinic shift
obligations.description: Help at a settlement fever clinic. One three-day shift fulfills the promise and pays 10 gold.

obligations.title: Answer your hometown’s plea
obligations.description: Visit the fever clinic or bring a remedy to Mossbell.

journal.title: A life begins
journal.text: Born in Mossbell, Legacy Sable grows up in a struggling household. The regional crisis is Ashfall fever. Your ambition: Protect the place I call home.

journal.title: A friendship at the wellside
journal.text: At seven, you spoke up when I was falsely accused.

journal.title: An education earned
journal.text: A service scholarship opened the academy through learning and a promise.

journal.title: A teacher’s question
journal.text: You asked what the prohibition protected. A discreet teacher remembers the question.

journal.title: Eighteen, and a life to make
journal.text: Your adult life begins in Mossbell. Work, learn, make time for people, and choose what to become. Mira can join you in any settlement. Your combat path is mage; your ambition is “Protect the place I call home.”

journal.title: A plea from the village
journal.text: Consult the academy in Larkspire, or help at a settlement clinic. Your hometown’s plea is in the journal.

journal.title: A profession alongside a path
journal.text: You begin work as a healer. Your mage path remains your way of fighting.

journal.title: A living earned
journal.text: Three days of healer work earned 24 gold. Work at Mossbell keeps you part of the community.

journal.title: A companion, not an equipment slot
journal.text: Mira joins your party. Their goals and values remain their own.

journal.title: A road taken
journal.text: 3 days from Mossbell brings you to Larkspire.

journal.title: Experience becomes confidence
journal.text: You reached level 2. Your health and magical reserves grew.

journal.title: Initiated as a necromancer
journal.text: You earned the necromancer specialization. Your livelihood and personal history continue. Your practice began with consensual ancestral study, without an automatic criminal record.
